report.summary: Patient P-D004 (51M, Spanish-speaking, commercial Employer PPO with no transport benefit) screens positive for transportation need and needs med-cost support for losartan ($10/mo copay). Med-cost options: Clinic Rx Fund (current-patient copay help, likely eligible), Community Pharmacy Assistance (Extra Help/manufacturer program applications), Neighborhood Pharmacy Fund (case-number referral). Transport options: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA certification, up to 21 days) is the best fit; Senior Shuttle West (age 60+) and Medicaid Ride Line (commercial coverage) are not eligible. No facility location on file for the Oct 19 16:00 appointment, so transit feasibility could not be verified; home tract is low-income with limited vehicle access.

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Ask clinic social work/front desk to apply for short-term copay assistance; patient is a current patient seen today.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Request help applying for Extra Help and manufacturer copay programs; note Extra Help is primarily Medicare-based.

options.name: Neighborhood Pharmacy Fund
options.how_to_access: Referral requires a case number; use http://127.0.0.1:42725/x/r?case=<record number>

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Call to apply for ADA paratransit certification; decisions take up to 21 days, so apply well before appointments.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Not eligible — patient is 51; service is for adults 60+. Listed only to rule out.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Not eligible — patient has commercial Employer PPO with no transport benefit, not Medicaid.
